children: Assure DeFi has verified more than 1,500 projects, covering over $2 billion in verified value. According to Odaily, the team said it will no longer accept new business, while completed KYC and audits will remain valid and all verification and audit records will stay publicly searchable. Most of the team has shifted to developing the Brainverse project, which is now running more than 100 AI agents in its own operations.

title: Assure DeFi Stops Accepting New Business After Verifying More Than 1,500 Projects
